title: Expected distribution
view: Shared head base (visuals/distribution_bases/head): skeleton bust on the left, grey bust on the right, both turned three-quarters toward the image right so the patient's right cheek and right ear face the viewer; right-sided block.
teachingPoint: An inferior alveolar block numbs all the lower teeth on one side and the body of the mandible, with the lower lip and chin.
claims: Bone: all the lower teeth on one side and the body of the mandible (inferior alveolar nerve in the mandibular canal).
Skin: lower lip and chin to the midline (mental branch).
Not shaded: the ramus (masseteric and other branches), the upper face. The lingual nerve (tongue) is not visible on this figure.
Right-sided block (patient's right ear and cheek face the viewer); one tone per nerve, key shown under the image in the app.
